patterns.name: Atomic Deployment
patterns.description: Build locally, push to registry, pull to OCI. Avoid building on restricted resources.

patterns.name: Context Locking
patterns.description: Storing raw math in Architect context. Use Translator Layer instead to ensure Model Agnosticism.

patterns.name: Gravity Well Alignment
patterns.description: Ensure new features respect the 'Gravity' of existing modules (e.g. Biology code stays in Biology module).
